name: Noa
source:
The "interface" created by the Black Moon to interact with humans. She has little regard for human life and is not hesitant to sacrifice humans to accomplish her goals.

[Based on [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Noa_(interface)]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]
